name: Shell Company Screening Agent
description: A Deep Research agent for identifying, screening, and evaluating listed shell companies as potential candidates for reverse mergers, reverse takeovers, and other M&A transactions.
provider_note: Runs on OpenAI / OpenRouter / Gemini / Perplexity Deep Research (configured server-side).

fields.label: Client Name
fields.description: Name of the client or organization commissioning the shell company screening task.

fields.label: Target Listed Market
fields.description: Listed market or jurisdiction in which shell company candidates should be identified.

fields.label: Research Cut-off Date
fields.description: Latest date up to which information should be considered.

fields.label: Control Requirement
fields.placeholder: Describe any ownership or control requirements
fields.description: Describes any client requirement regarding ownership, effective control, or the desired control path.

fields.label: Capital Structure Preference
fields.placeholder: Describe any capital structure preferences or constraints
fields.description: Describes any client preference regarding convertible bonds, legacy financing instruments, or other capital-structure complexity.

fields.label: Warrant and Dilution Preference
fields.placeholder: Describe any dilution-related preferences or constraints
fields.description: Describes any client preference regarding warrants, options, convertible securities, or other potential dilution.

fields.label: Reporting, Legal and Regulatory Requirement
fields.placeholder: Describe any reporting, legal, or regulatory requirements
fields.description: Describes any client-specific requirements regarding reporting, audit status, litigation, regulatory matters, suspension risk, or other compliance issues.

fields.label: Historical Financing Preference
fields.placeholder: Describe any preferences regarding historical financing
fields.description: Describes any client preference regarding historical financing arrangements.

fields.label: Market Capitalization Requirement
fields.placeholder: e.g. Below HKD 500 million, or no fixed threshold
fields.description: Defines any market-capitalization requirement. If no threshold is specified, market capitalization is treated as a reference for transaction scale and economics rather than as a hard filter.

fields.label: Transaction Objective
fields.description: Describes the intended transaction objective and planned use of the listed platform.

fields.label: Additional Client Requirements
fields.placeholder: Add any other transaction constraints, preferences, or exclusions
fields.description: Any additional transaction constraints, preferences, exclusions, or client-specific requirements not covered above.

fields.label: Additional Context
fields.placeholder: Add any relevant background or context
fields.description: Optional background information or non-public context that may help the agent interpret the client mandate.
